Game Overview

At its heart, Monster City is a dinosaur game about unleash your inner dinosaur in Monster City, where chaos reigns supreme. Smash through towering skyscrapers and siphon their energy to grow stronger. Engage in exhilarating battles with rival monsters and amass a devoted monstrous crew, creating your ultimate reign of urban devastation. Indulge in the thrill of wanton destruction!
